# marketingskills: third-party notice

Allevia's marketing, analytics and copy skills borrow the methods of eight skills from Corey Haines's `marketingskills`
collection: email sequences, SMS and WhatsApp marketing (with its WhatsApp platform and compliance references), referral
programmes, churn prevention and win-back, conversion checks on a page (CRO), attribution, the seven-sweeps copy edit,
and social content.

| | |
|---|---|
| Repository | https://github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills |

| Files taken | `LICENSE`, and `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` for `emails`, `sms`, `referrals`, `churn-prevention`, `cro`, `attribution`, `copy-editing` and `social`, plus `skills/sms/references/whatsapp.md` and `skills/sms/references/compliance.md`; all verbatim at that commit, kept under the same `<name>/` paths here |

Copyright stays with the original author; `LICENSE` here is the verbatim licence text from that commit. The other 42 skills
in the collection were read and mapped (see `docs/tool-scout.md`) but not copied: they are written for SaaS teams, or
another builder already owns the area (SEO check-ups, Apify research, poster making).

How it is used: these files are kept as the reference. They are Claude Code skills written for a marketer working on
SaaS or e-commerce, and they are **not** loaded by Allevia. Their methods are restated for the owner of a small business
(a salon, a studio, a shop, a local service; US, UK, UAE and Australia), in plain words and with Allevia's own tools, in:

| Our skill | Who uses it | Built from |
|---|---|---|
| `skills/ops-manager/bring-customers-back/SKILL.md` | Vikram, ops | `emails`, `sms` (+ `references/whatsapp.md`, `references/compliance.md`), `referrals`, `churn-prevention` |
| `skills/data-analyst/page-that-should-sell/SKILL.md` | Kabir, analytics | `cro` |
| `skills/data-analyst/which-channel-brings-customers/SKILL.md` | Kabir, analytics | `attribution` |
| `skills/copy-editor/seven-sweeps-edit/SKILL.md` | Dev, copy | `copy-editing`, and the "no AI tells" lists in `social` and `emails` |

Nothing from these files is evidence: a skill tells the team how to work, and every number in an answer still comes from
the business's own records. Platform facts in `sms/references/whatsapp.md` (WhatsApp pricing, limits, the 24-hour window)
are dated 2026-10 by the author; the skills tell the team to check Meta's current rate card before quoting a cost.
